ModMetaData.name: VPE - Phantom Hand
ModMetaData.author: darky
ModMetaData.description:
A Vanilla Psycasts Expanded path that summons short-lived hands of telekinetic force to work, rescue and fight on their own. Mud and shallow water don't slow them, and they fade within an in-game hour. The caster's psychic sensitivity sets how many come, how fast they move and how skilled they are.
Psycasts: - Busy Hands: hands that haul to storage anywhere on the map, following your hauling priorities. - Timber Hands: hands that cut trees and plants marked for cutting. - Phantom Construction Crew: hands that build, deliver materials and repair. Their skill sets build quality. - Miner Hands: hands that mine marked rock and ore. - Telekinetic Aura: a toggle that summons a working hand every 20 seconds for whatever work is waiting. It locks 30 of the caster's neural heat while it lasts. - Rescue Hands: hands that carry downed allies to hospital beds, even with enemies nearby. - Grasping Hands: seize every enemy in an area for about 10 seconds. They can barely move, and their aim suffers. - Thousand Palms: battle hands that block bullets, strike fast and shove enemies back. - The Hundred-Handed: a swarm of up to 40 hands that fights and rescues during a raid and works otherwise. Once per day.
Good to know: - Hands add nothing to colony wealth, send no letters and leave no corpses. - The work and rescue psycasts can be cast without drafting. - Hands vanish if their caster is downed, dies or leaves the map. - Requires Biotech: the hands run on the mechanoid work system, with no mechanitor or bandwidth needed. - Find it on VPE's Arcanum tab.
Inspired by the summons of A RimWorld of Magic.
